texts.facts: The writ petition was filed seeking permission to conduct a marriage in the auditorium in question. The writ petition was filed seeking permission to conduct a marriage in the auditorium in question. The prayer in this Writ Petition was a declaration that the petitioner is not required to take any separate licence for approval in view of the registration certificate granted for Micro Small and Medium Enterprises. This Writ Petition was filed seeking permission to conduct a wedding on 14.06.2024. This Court had declined the interim relief by order dated 13.06.2024, but the petitioner conducted a function, which led to this Court passing an order on 18.07.2024 imposing a cost of Rs.1,00,000/-. This was issued as a consequence of the issuance of the stop memo by the Corporation.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the same has become infructuous. Accordingly, the same is dismissed as infructuous. This Writ Petition is filled by claiming a deemed licence under the provisions of the Kerala Municipality Act. Accordingly, the same is dismissed as infructuous. Learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the Corporation submitted that the application could not be processed on account of the arrears of property tax payable by the owner of the building.
